user.title: Fosi Audio
user.description: Enter the IP address of the streamer. The device must be awake and reachable.

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: Enter the streamer's new IP address. Entities and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. If it is on wifi it may be asleep - start playback and try again.
error.not_streamsdk: Responded, but does not look like a StreamSDK device.

abort.wrong_device: That address is a different device. Add it as a new integration instead.

init.title: Fosi Audio options
init.description: The source map is JSON. An entry needs a "path" to be selectable: role "activate" invokes an action node, role "value" writes the given "value". An entry with only a "state" is reported but never offered as an option, which is how the network sources work. Confirm the real indices by watching settings:/custom/lastAudioSource while switching inputs on the remote.

data_description.sources: Leave blank to restore the shipped defaults.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the device's state. Longer is gentler on a device on wifi.

error.invalid_sources: Not valid JSON, or an entry is missing a 'path' or 'state'.

seek_relative.name: Seek relative
seek_relative.description: Jump forward or backward from the current position.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Seconds to jump. Negative values seek backwards.
